systems.system: Multi-Satellite Integration Meteorological Transportable Ground Application System (TGAS)

note: Only a pledge and MoU for a donated receiving system, addressed to the environment ministry; no national weather service reception stated.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Botswana among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.

note: The document lists ground stations and a remote sensing unit without saying the weather service receives or uses satellite data.
